title: Cranberry Oat Bars
changes_from_base: A brown sugar oat dough base and topping around a tart cooked cranberry layer, replacing caramel and chocolate.
summary: Brown sugar oat bars with a cooked cranberry layer and pecans.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Boil the cranberries, sugar and water 2-3 min, stirring, until the berries burst and the juice thickens. Cool 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan), shelf just below the middle, and line the tin. Whisk the oats, flour, cinnamon and salt.

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Beat the butter and brown sugar 3 min until fluffy, beat in the egg, then mix in the oat mixture on low.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Press two-thirds of the dough into the tin, spread the cranberries over, mix the pecans into the remaining dough and dot it over in walnut-sized pieces.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 40-45 min, turning halfway, until golden on top. Cool about 2 h, then cut into 24.

tips: Frozen cranberries can go straight into the pan.
Let the cranberry mixture cool so it does not melt the dough.
Leave the topping in pieces so the red shows through.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
